messages:
maria: quick check — support ticket 4289 needs us to inspect a staging request/response to repro a crash. are we allowed to pull full bodies from staging? what PII redaction rules apply here? also, i saw an Authorization header with a token in the sample — should that be masked in logs?
ajay: staging logs are sampled and go through the scrubber. we should NOT have raw bearer tokens in logs. if you see them, that's a bug. generally: remove/mask Authorization, emails, SSNs, CVVs, full creditcards, and raw prompts that contain user-entered text.
sophia: FYI policy link: https://redwood.internal/policies/logging#pii — TL;DR: ephemeral captures allowed with approval, must run redaction pipeline and store only hashed identifiers.
maria: thanks. i need to capture a specific endpoint POST /api/v1/transform to reproduce. can we do a scoped temp capture instead of pulling entire log index?
ryan: yes — favor targeted capture. we have a temp-capture feature on staging. you can enable a flag for the service that writes to a secured bucket for 6h. requires a one-line justification and approver (security).
ajay: config snippet (staging only):
```json
{"TEMP_CAPTURE":"true","TEMP_CAPTURE_FILTER":"{\"paths\":[\"/api/v1/transform\"],\"headers\":[\"Authorization\"]}"}
```
Note: the capture filter will automatically redact headers listed, but body fields need explicit scrub rules.
maria: can we add a scrub rule to hash user_id and redact prompt text?
ajay: yes — add scrub rules in the same config:
```json
{"SCRUB_RULES":[{"json_path":"$.user_id","action":"hash"},{"json_path":"$.prompt","action":"redact"}]}
```
that will hash user_id and replace prompt with "[REDACTED]" in the captured file.
sophia: also remember to exclude full token capture: in staging we still never store raw tokens. the scrubbing pipeline will remove Authorization header values even if mistakenly captured, but we should not rely on that.
sec-bot: audit reminder — any temp capture must include JIRA id and approver. Audit entry will be created automatically.
maria: JIRA: RED-4289. Requesting temp capture for 6h to reproduce crash, will run the scrub pipeline and attach redacted sample to ticket. Approver: @ryan.
ryan: approved for 6h, scope limited to /api/v1/transform, must run scrubbing rules shown above and upload to RED-4289 when done. I will request the staging-log-viewer role be granted for your account for the window.
maria: thanks — i'll enable flag now and DM the bucket link when done. will confirm samples are redacted before anyone outside eng sees them. :thumbsup:
ajay: one more note — please include a short postmortem blurb in the ticket if the root cause is related to user input handling so we can add an automated scrub or a validation to avoid future captures.
maria: will do. closing the loop here once upload is done.
sec-bot: audit entry created: actor=ryan, target=maria, scope=/api/v1/transform, duration=6h, jira=RED-4289.
